reviews.comment: There really isn't much lecture and the class meetings are fueled by the discussion between students and him. If you miss more than 3 lectures he will drop your grade by an entire letter. He does not check his email and does not respond to students unless pestered.

I did the math for this semesters reading requirements... 7 books. 1,871 pages. ~60 hours of reading time. Multiple movies. You don't need to put any effort into this class, just SHOW UP and sit there. He hates AI, cancelled class prob 6+ times, and really just wants students to keep him company. Didn't learn a thing but I'd do it all again 100%.

Really enjoyed this class, but as someone just needing a lit credit to graduate, this was a lot more reading than I was used to. Most work done outside of class, reading about 1 novel every week or two, but he would also assign cool movies. 150-word response due every day before class for completion. 2 big papers, actually fun to write. Great guy
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Amazing professor! He is understanding, caring, and makes class fun. As long as you show up and do the assignments that are almost all completion grades with the exception of the 2 papers, you will get an A. Simple short answer writing assignments, in class writing once a week, and 2 papers. Didn't add any stress to my life.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: As someone who loves creative writing but hasn't taken any classes on it before now, it was incredibly helpful. Prof has tons of really helpful insight for stories and helps you avoid mistakes you never even realized you were making. I have seen a sizable improvement in my writing in only the four months of taking this class. Would take again.

He is honestly the best! Just go to the classes and somewhat participate and you'll be just fine. He actually cares about the students and is very understanding. Would totally take him again. Lots of reading assignments and two major papers but that is it.

The class was pretty fast paced in terms of how much we read, but the homework is so easy and there were only two papers that I felt he was an easy grader on. I loved going to class because he made it interesting. You can tell he cares about his students and his material. Amazing professor, I'm def taking again!

One of the kindest, most accommodating professors I've ever had. Assigns readings, but the homework is super easy- he just cares if you do it or not. Has great life stories and is very encouraging towards students. Has honestly helped me through a lot of difficult life events. Absolutely take him if you can, he's a wonderful human being.

I love him! He is so caring and seems to genuinely enjoy talking to the students. Only two papers and discussions every week. Most of the readings, if not all, are accessible through the library or online. Sometimes we watch films as well! Such a great course and a great professor! Funny as well!

Dr. White is a nice guy overall and this class is a free A if you are willing to complete assignments. There are 4 main writing pieces you give, and a revised version of these. They take time, but if you don't procrastinate it is easy to finish them. Dr. White gives short feedback on pieces, but he will expand if you ask him to.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: A reasonable amount of reading, super easy assignments. Two or three large writing pieces total, but he's a very chill grader. Overall super easygoing and funny professor. Just do the homework and show up and you'll be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Lots of reading, but he spreads it out evenly throughout the semester. He is super passionate about this subject, so just do the readings and participate in class, and you will do just fine.

Dr White was a really cool professor and a great writer. Definitely had some strong opinions on certain topics but other than that he was awesome. Weekly discussion posts and readings, 3 short stories (5-8 pages long) and 8 poems. Very doable, make sure you pay attention in class and ask for feedback.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor White is an amazing professor. His classes are enjoyable and he has led a life full of interesting experiences that he will occasionally share with the class. Fair grader too. Would definitely recommend!

Dr. White is a great writer, not necessarily a great professor. He gives excellent feedback, he just doesn't know how to run a classroom. Don't be discouraged, it's not that he doesn't teaching (at least, I don't think), he's just better at writing than he is at instructing. That being said, I would recommend the class. I learned a lot.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lots of assignments, and very time consuming. He also graded very harsh and rarely gave above a 90 until the end of the class. It also took him FOREVER to grade things. He was very nice and approachable and willing to help tho. For an english class, the amount of work was absolutely ridiculous

Dr. White is a good professor, and while he grades very harshly at the beginning of the semester, if you show interest in the course and ask for help when you need it, he grades less harshly. He is very understanding, and ultimately meeting with him only a few times helped me understand many of the assignments a lot more than asking peers.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: There are A LOT of assignments for this class (multiple a week). There's major essays, projects, and minor projects. Just be prepared for a lot of writing and planning. However, the content is not difficult just time-consuming. This is one of the most organized classes I've ever had. He's the typical English prof that never gives you a 100 though.

I took Professor White solely because he had good ratings on RateMyProf. He does seem to be a very nice and caring prof but as an engineering major required to take this course, it is way too much. I also have not received a ton of feedback yet on my assignments but the grades I have gotten are definitely not what I hoped/expected.

As an engineer here, DO NOT TAKE HIM FOR ENGL210 TECHNICAL BUSINESS WRITING! There are over 50 writing assignments in total, including a few big research papers near the end. It is insane how often papers are due, and the writing topics are super unrealistic. Unless you are a business major who loves writing for hours, dont take him
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Great professor. There is small writing assignment twice a week (about 150 words each), but he really only cares that you do it, not about quality. Literally just turn in all the assignments on time, and you'll get full credit. If you just do the work, you should get an A in the class. There was two extra credit opportunities.

Dr. White is a more traditional professor and does not really tolerate late work. But his grading rubrics and expectations are clear and he seems to be fairly lenient on grading. It is not a homework heavy class, but there is a lot of writing involved, however he and the TA are extremely helpful and just an email away.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. White is honestly an amazing professor. He gives great advice and not too much homework. The focus is actually on the quality of work and any assignments given help work toward improving writing. If the work is done on time and you actually put effort in, you should be fine. He is very laid-back while not being so to the point that it's boring.
Dr. White is a great prof. During the Coronavirus of spring 2020 he cut our reading down considerably. Really caring and cool dude.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. White is an old hipster mixed with hobo chic. It's awesome. He has really good taste in writing and gives great feedback on your stories. Sometimes the grading criteria is really unclear and his syllabus leaves something to be desired, but overall he's a really good professor to have read your stories. Take him if you have a chance!

Overall my favorite class this semester, very relaxed not stressful. There is a good amount of reading but the books are intriguing. He is really sweet and understanding. You'll learn a lot and you won't hate your life. 3 essay exams and tons of extra credit.

I struggle with writing, yet I took Writer's Workshop to satisfy a credit I needed for my University Writing Requirement. I am SO glad I took his class. Dr. White is understanding, helpful, and entertaining. We even draw in class for daily credit. Nothing was overwhelming. I'm taking his Lit of the Am. Southwest in the spring.
He tells great stories and it is a fun class to take. If you are looking for a super structured class this is not is but you do learn and he does help you. Very nice and cares about his students.

This class will stretch you as a writer and will certainly make you better. You are asked to participate in class and often share your writing but he is encouraging & constructive when you do. I learned a ton from his class and appreciated how he told stories & was involved in our stories. A very easy B if you do the assignments but harder to get A

Professor White is hands down the best English professor at Texas A&M. Sure he wasn't on Ellen like Dr. Musoma was, but he would be a killer guest. I have never had a professor more engaging than him. He really enjoys what he does and makes an effort to help his students. Class is relatively easy, couple of stories and poems to turn in.

This was my second course with Dr. White, and it was even better than the first. As far as writing-based classes go, Dr. White is pretty laid-back and easy going. He is happy to work with you if you need it, and the work load is by no means overwhelming. I definitely recommend him for any creative writing class.

Dr. White is nice, fun, and helpful. I loved what we did and, though there was a good amount of work, I didn't feel like I was drowning. He's kind and loves to talk about life. If anything, the class wasn't tough enough for me or intellectually stimulating. But I did love the class and Dr. White.

Absolutely LOVED his class. We had readings due before most classes, but they were short and fun to read. I really enjoyed going to class everyday to hear what new stories Dr. White had to tell us, and everyday something a little different. Would most definitely recommend that you take a class of his! Such a fun professor!
Professor Lowell White is the best professor at TAMU. This class was easy and fun!

Literally the easiest class. As long as you show up to class than you should be fine. He does require you to speak out loud a lot but just do it! Its worth it! especially at the end of the year when you need that 2 point curve. Not a lot of reading and only four major papers throughout the course. I totally recommend him.
Great Prof, class is always entertaining and he usually lets you out early! He does demand some good writing out of you, so you need to put effort in your writing! Definitely recommend him for 235!

Great prof. funny. loved going to lecture. You will have several papers and a group project. i am a better writer because of him and would love to take a class with him again. I will say that he was pretty darn tough on grading. he demands your best. You are forced to be creative if you are not already.
Really laid back he wont stress if you don't stress. and speak up in his class it makes him sad if you don't
First couple weeks i didnt like him but give him a chance and you'll probably really enjoy his class. He made it fun and easy, i definitely recommend him.
Fantastic! Very interesting.
He cares...

Awesome Prof... Fun discussions and enjoyable papers to write.  It isn't the easiest class in the world but i was able to get an A in the shortened summer session. (hint untilize freewrites and office hours)
